_readme: Optional site-wide banner shown under the header on every page. Set 'enabled' to true and fill in the fields for venue changes, cancellations, O-Week notices etc. 'severity' is 'info' (navy) or 'urgent' (gold). Set dates (YYYY-MM-DD) to auto-show/hide, or leave empty to control by hand. Only one banner is supported deliberately - keep it for things that matter.
message: The Roncalli Lecture returns after almost a decade - David Smith MP on Contemporary Questions of Human Dignity, Wednesday 21 October, 6:00-7:15 pm, Hedley Bull Building Theatre 1. Free, all welcome.
